hero.summary_en: Deutscher Galopp is production-routed for Germany's reviewed gallop system; other horse-racing codes remain outside the current Calendar scope.
hero.summary_ja: ドイツでは確認済みDeutscher Galoppギャロップ体系をproduction経路に接続済みです。他の競馬体系は現在のCalendar対象外です。

paragraphs_en: The official Deutscher Galopp 2026 annual calendar is used as the gallop meeting mother set, with the official race calendar supplying published per-race post times through A. Country-level public display remains capped at C because other German horse-racing codes have not been reviewed.
paragraphs_ja: Deutscher Galopp公式2026年年間日程をギャロップ開催母表として使用し、公式レースカレンダーから公開済みレース時刻をAまで取得します。他のドイツ競馬体系が未確認のため、国全体の公開上限はCのままです。

calendar_guidance_en: Use Deutscher Galopp for the reviewed gallop scope. Preserve stronger canonical timing evidence, but publish Germany at C until other racing codes are reviewed.

coverage_note_en: Production routing covers Deutscher Galopp gallop only; it is not a claim of complete multi-code German horse-racing coverage.
